title: The geometric case of the Erdős similarity conjecture

abstractEnglish: We prove the geometric-progression case of the Erdős similarity conjecture. For every fixed $`q\in(0,1)`$ and every $`\eta\in(0,1)`$, we construct a compact set $`E_{q,\eta}\subseteq[0,1]`$ of measure greater than $`1-\eta`$ containing no nontrivial affine copy of $`\{q^n:n\ge1\}`$, for any translation and either sign of nonzero dilation. The set may depend on q; the result makes no simultaneous assertion for different ratios.
